title: Persistence of Rejection
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y$ be a bit string, and let $c$ be a configuration of the tabulating machine associated with $M$ on input $y$. If after $s$ steps this machine is halted and its output is the one-bit word $0$, then for every $s' \\ge s$ it is still halted after $s'$ steps and its output remains $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of the tabulating machine on input $y$
After $s$ steps the machine is halted
$s'$ is a natural number with $s \\le s'$
